Requirements Your last action was a successful Strike against a tech creature, hazard, or item. You transmit a virus that hampers the operation of the required target. The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] against the higher of your class DC or spell DC with the following results.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to Transmit Virus for 1 hour.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Glitching]{Glitching 1}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Glitching]{Glitching 2}.
